The '''Liberty Movement''' was a military junta based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Carratos]]. When the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] abandoned Carratos in the wake of the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the Liberty Movement ransacked the Imperial garrison and destroyed nearly all of Carratos' government files, including criminal records. As a result, every criminal on Carratos was essentially given a clean slate, and the planet descended into lawlessness.<ref name="EGTPM" />
